airports.name: OurAirports
airports.attribution: Airport data from OurAirports, released into the public domain.

disposable-email.name: Disposable email domains
disposable-email.attribution: Disposable domain list from the disposable-email-domains project (CC0).

holidays-bank.name: Bank holidays in India
holidays-bank.attribution: Bank holidays from the Reserve Bank of India holiday matrix, by regional office.
holidays-bank.notes: Holidays under the Negotiable Instruments Act and the banks' closing of accounts. An office's holidays are attributed to the states it covers; union territories without an office are not guessed.

holidays-central.name: Central government holidays
holidays-central.publisher: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
holidays-central.attribution: Gazetted and restricted holidays for central government offices, from the yearly Department of Personnel and Training memorandum.
holidays-central.notes: Typed in by hand each year from the memorandum, usually published in July for the following year. State government holiday lists are not included.

holidays-market.name: Trading and clearing holidays, NSE equities
holidays-market.attribution: Trading and clearing holidays from the National Stock Exchange of India, capital market segment.

hsn.name: HSN and SAC codes
hsn.publisher: Customs Tariff Act, 1975 (First Schedule) and GST notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), as published on the GST portal
hsn.licence: Statute and gazette notification; reproduction permitted by section 52(1)(q) of the Copyright Act, 1957
hsn.attribution: HSN codes from the First Schedule to the Customs Tariff Act, 1975, and SAC codes from the annexure to notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), in the copy published on the GST portal.

ifsc.name: IFSC dataset
ifsc.publisher: Razorpay, compiled from Reserve Bank of India and NPCI lists
ifsc.licence: Public domain (dataset), as stated by the publisher
ifsc.attribution: IFSC data from the open razorpay/ifsc dataset, compiled from Reserve Bank of India and NPCI publications.

logos.name: Indian listed company logos
logos.licence: Logos are trademarks of the companies they identify
logos.attribution: Company logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
logos.notes: Compiled dataset; the README records where the files and company details were collected from.

mutual-funds.name: Net asset values of mutual fund schemes
mutual-funds.publisher: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
mutual-funds.licence: Published by AMFI under SEBI's disclosure rules
mutual-funds.attribution: Net asset values as published by the Association of Mutual Funds in India.

pincode.name: All India Pincode Directory
pincode.publisher: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India
pincode.attribution: Contains data from the All India Pincode Directory, Department of Posts, published on data.gov.in under the Government Open Data License - India.
pincode.notes: The portal refuses scripted downloads, so this copy came from the mirror github.com/dropdevrahul/pincodes-india (commit d817d3e652e8). Its size matches the file size the portal lists for the official resource, last changed there on 2026-08-10.

rto.name: List of Regional Transport Office districts in India
rto.attribution: RTO codes adapted from the Wikipedia article "List of Regional Transport Office districts in India", licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. This dataset is shared under the same licence.

stations.name: List of railway stations in India
stations.attribution: Station codes adapted from the Wikipedia article "List of railway stations in India", licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. This dataset is shared under the same licence.

thirukkural.name: Thirukkural
thirukkural.publisher: Thiruvalluvar; compiled as JSON by github.com/tk120404/thirukkural
thirukkural.licence: Public domain text and translations; the compilation is Apache-2.0
thirukkural.attribution: Thirukkural text with English translations by G.U. Pope (1886) and by W.H. Drew and John Lazarus (1840, 1885), from the tk120404/thirukkural compilation (Apache-2.0).
